subject: CPPO intake: ResellCo SKU consumption & capacity alignment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@resellco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Angela Morris <angela.morris@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T16:03:00Z
Subject: CPPO intake: preliminary SKU/listing and monthly consumption forecast

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this — we're excited to get EdgeScale's listing across the CPPO path. Attached is a first-pass SKU map (resellco_sku_map_v3.xlsx) and a simple forecast for Q3/Q4 usage tied to customer pilots. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether the SKUs can map 1:1 to CPPO SKUs or if Redwood needs consolidated entitlements.
- Guidance on invoice aliasing (we need billing under "EdgeScale Systems US LLC").
- Estimated lead time from DocuSign to CPPO activation on AWS.

A couple of constraints: some of our pilot customers will require invoicing split by entity. We also anticipate a spike mid-July tied to a product launch.

Attaching: resellco_sku_map_v3.xlsx

Appreciate any initial intake notes so we can prep procurement and legal.

Best,
Samir
Head of Partnerships
ResellCo (EdgeScale Systems)

--
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Angela Morris <angela.morris@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-06-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: CPPO intake: preliminary SKU/listing and monthly consumption forecast

Samir — thanks for the packet, uploaded and reviewed quickly. A few notes from intake: 

1) SKU mapping: it looks like 7 discrete SKUs. Our CPPO path prefers a 1:1 mapping where practical; I'll confirm exceptions after Ben and Soojin validate entitlement boundaries.

2) Billing alias: fine in principle; we need the official legal entity name, tax ID, and a PO or written confirmation from procurement to pass to AWS.

3) Timeline: rough CPPO activation window is 2–3 weeks after DocuSign if no entitlement reconciliation is required; if we need entity splits or invoice aliasing we'll add ~1 week for billing ops.

Next steps: Ben — can you validate the SKU-to-entitlement mapping and flag any that will need consolidation?
Soojin — could you own the CPPO evidence checklist / AWS Partner SE handoff and coordinate the DocuSign templates with Marissa?

Samir — if you can send the procurement contact (procurement@edge-scale.com) and confirm the expected July spike volumes per SKU, we'll prioritize the SKU that will see the highest consumption.

Thanks — Mina
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

--
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@resellco.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T17:25:00Z
Subject: Re: CPPO intake: preliminary SKU/listing and monthly consumption forecast

Mina / team — dug into the SKU map. Quick summary:

- SKU_A, SKU_B, SKU_C: map cleanly to our per-seat/per-instance CPPO SKUs. No consolidation required.
- SKU_D and SKU_E: overlap on metering (feature flags) — recommend we consolidate under a single entitle SKU to simplify CPPO ops; I'll call that SKU_D* in the attached notes.
- SKU_F: usage-based token SKU — needs explicit consumption buckets in the CPPO template (we should define a monthly committed baseline to get better pricing).
- SKU_G: professional services SKU — not a CPPO product; ResellCo should invoice separately.

Action items:
- Ben: create an entitlement mapping doc and recommended CPPO SKU names (in progress) — ETA 2028-06-06.
- Soojin: start evidence checklist and loop AWS SE (Angela) for partner verification.

I'll include short notes about impact to billing split for SKU_D consolidation; finance will need to pre-approve.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Channel
Redwood Inference

Attachment: entitlement_notes_draft.txt (referenced inline)

--
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Angela Morris <angela.morris@amazon.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@resellco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T13:54:00Z
Subject: AWS SE handoff and CPPO evidence checklist

Hi Angela / team — looping you in to start the CPPO SE validation. We've got a reseller (EdgeScale / ResellCo) prepping a private offer with the following needs: 

- SKU consolidation for two overlapping feature SKUs (Ben recommends single entitlement SKU_D*).
- Invoice aliasing to "EdgeScale Systems US LLC" with entity tax info; procurement contact is procurement@edge-scale.com.
- Monthly committed baseline for usage-based token SKU (propose 250M tokens/month for initial CPPO pricing).

Samir — can you confirm tax ID and provide a point of contact for DocuSign execution? Also confirm whether July spike is limited to SKU_F (token SKU) or spread across SKU_A/B.

Angela — do we need any additional evidence (proof of partner relationship, reseller agreement) beyond the standard CPPO checklist? If you can share the checklist link or quick requirements, Soojin will assemble and push to shared drive.

Thanks — Soojin
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations here: 

- Procurement: procurement@edge-scale.com (Sarah Kim, VP Finance), EIN: 12-3456789. Sarah will send a PO template and confirm the billing alias today.
- July spike: primarily SKU_F (token usage) — estimate 4x baseline for weeks 28–31 (mid-July to early-August). We want SKU_F prioritized so we can finish pilot billing without interruptions.
- DocuSign: Samir to sign MOU draft by 6/17; procurement will attach PO once we receive final CPPO SKU mapping.

Attachments: draft-mou-EdgeScale.docx (MOU + billing alias appendix)

If you need a short call to triage the SKU_D consolidation implications on entitlement and invoice split, I'm available 6/16 15:00-17:00 ET.

Appreciate the triage and prioritization.

Samir
Head of Partnerships
ResellCo (EdgeScale Systems)
